mapper.insert: insert into qa_message(conversation_id, user_id, role, content, created_time) values(#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{createdTime})
mapper.select: select id, conversation_id as conversationId, role, content, created_time as createdTime from qa_message where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and user_id = #{userId} order by created_time asc, id asc
